title: Rochdale AFC to host York City in League Two clash this Saturday
excerpt: Rochdale AFC welcomes York City to the Crown Oil Arena for a Sky Bet League Two match this Saturday, 12 November.
body:
Rochdale AFC will host York City at the Crown Oil Arena this Saturday, 12 November, in a Sky Bet League Two fixture.

Supporters are encouraged to attend and show their backing for the team as they strive for success in the league. The matchday guide is available on the Rochdale AFC official site for fans seeking more information.

This fixture is part of the ongoing league season, and fans are hopeful for a strong performance from their team after a challenging previous encounter.

The match is significant for local fans as both teams aim to improve their standings in the league.

corrections.note: Corrected on 12 November 2026: an earlier version stated a fact that the source reports differently. The article now reflects what Rochdale AFC reports.
